name: ai.privos.mcp-app-cv-matcher-dev
title: CV Matcher App
description: HR Mini App for PrivOS: recruitment pipeline with AI CV scoring, scored-CV kanban, JD editor, employee lifecycle, payroll, drafting bot and email history.

permissions.reason: Identify the approved installation and room so every HR tab loads the right room’s data.
Join the app installation agent bot to the current Room before starting mailbox OAuth so bot App Database calls are authorized.
Read candidate, employee and email-history lists of this room (mcpapp.lists.getAll/getItems/get/searchItems).
Create lists, fields and items for scored CVs, employee profiles and email history; move kanban cards between stages.
Read JD, CV, template and company files stored in the room (mcpapp.files.getByChannel/get/search/getContent, mcpapp.folders.*).
Upload scoring skills, JDs, generated documents and payroll exports; rename and delete processed CVs (app.uploadFile, mcpapp.files.update/delete).
Read this room’s payroll records, active email-template settings and recruitment departments through mcpapp.db.query; installation-bot payroll calls remain pinned to the verified caller room.
Create and update this room’s payroll records, active email-template settings and recruitment departments through mcpapp.db.create/update.
Read the payroll collection schema (mcpapp.db.getSchema) when diagnosing a room.
Register room-scoped payroll, email-template settings and recruitment-department collections on first write (mcpapp.db.registerCollection).
Poll AI generation results for CV scoring and the company summary (ai-messages.list).
permissions.degradedBehavior: CV scoring and the Company home summary cannot read AI results; manual scoring remains available.

permissions.reason: Start AI generation for CV scoring and the company summary (ai-messages.send / ai-messages.startGeneration).
permissions.degradedBehavior: AI scoring and the AI company summary are disabled; every other tab keeps working.

dataPolicy.retention: App data is retained until the installation or corresponding HR records are deleted.
